blogPosts.title: Energy-Saving Tips for Eltham Homes with Split Systems
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical advice for Eltham residents to reduce energy bills and improve efficiency when using split system air conditioners.
body: Split systems are a popular choice for Eltham homes due to their efficiency and targeted cooling, but without proper use, energy bills can soar. One of the simplest energy-saving tips is to set your thermostat to 24-25°C in summer and 18-20°C in winter. In Eltham's climate, where temperatures can fluctuate, using a programmable timer to adjust settings based on occupancy can reduce energy consumption by up to 20%. Avoid setting temperatures too low, as each degree below 24°C increases running costs significantly.

Regular maintenance is key to efficiency. In Eltham, clean or replace filters every month during peak seasons to ensure optimal airflow. Dirty filters force the system to work harder, using more electricity. Additionally, keep outdoor units clear of debris and foliage—Eltham's leafy suburbs can mean more garden maintenance, but trimming plants around the unit improves heat exchange. Below Temp recommends scheduling professional servicing twice yearly in Eltham to check refrigerant levels and clean coils, which can boost efficiency by 10-15%.

Home insulation plays a big role in energy savings. In Eltham, where homes may have older construction, sealing gaps around windows and doors prevents cool air from escaping. Use curtains or blinds during the hottest parts of the day to block solar heat gain. Eltham residents can also consider upgrading to double-glazing or adding insulation in walls and ceilings, which reduces the load on your split system and lowers energy use year-round.

Smart technology can enhance savings. Installing a Wi-Fi thermostat allows you to control your split system remotely via smartphone, perfect for Eltham homeowners who are out during the day. Zone control is another option—cooling only occupied rooms instead of the entire house. Below Temp offers installation of smart controls in Eltham, helping you tailor cooling to your lifestyle and reduce unnecessary energy expenditure.

Finally, be mindful of usage patterns. In Eltham, take advantage of cooler mornings and evenings by turning off the AC and opening windows for natural ventilation. During heatwaves, close up early in the day to keep cool air in. By combining these tips with professional advice from Below Temp, Eltham homes can enjoy comfortable indoor climates without excessive energy costs, contributing to both savings and environmental sustainability.
